entries.source: Monumenta Boica. 43 \= Collectio nova 16, Monumenta Episcopatus Wirziburgensis
entries.german: Jch Hans Pfall von Rosenberg bekenne offenlich an diesem briefe, daz mir der erwirdige in got vater vnd herre myne gnediger herre her Gerhart biſchoff tzu Wirtzburg betzalt hatt hur vnd fert XII pfunt heller wirtzburger werünge von myns burkgütes wegen zu Hohenbürg. Vnd sage in der zwolff pfunt heller vff diese zwey jare quit ledig vnd losz. Vnd gieb im dez diesen offen brieff, beſiegelt mit mynem eygen jnsiegel. Datum jn die epiphanie dominj anno dominj millesimo CCCmo LXXX quarto. Cujus mentio facta est sigillum cera viridi inferiori harum litterarum chartacearum margini impressum est.
entries.english: I, Hans Pfall of Rosenberg, openly acknowledge by this letter that the venerable in God, my father and lord, my gracious lord Gerhart, bishop of Würzburg, has paid me twelve pounds Heller in Würzburg currency for my feudal estate in Hohenbürg. And I declare myself completely free and released from these twelve pounds Heller for these two years. And I give him this open letter, sealed with my own seal. Dated on the Epiphany of the Lord in the year of the Lord one thousand three hundred and eighty-four. Whose mention is made, the seal in green wax is impressed on the lower margin of these paper letters.
